camel_example: aliyun iot CreateOTAModule --region cn-hangzhou --ModuleName barcodeScanner --ProductKey a1Le6d00000
description_en: Creates an OTA module for a product
description_zh: 调用该接口创建产品的OTA模块
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-ota-module --module-name barcodeScanner --product-key a1Le6d00000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOTAModule

parameters.help_en: The alias of the OTA module. The alias can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: OTA模块别名。支持中文、英文字母、数字、英文句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_），长度限制为1~64个字符
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OTA module. The name must be unique within the product and cannot be modified. The name can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). It must be 1 to 64 characters in length.
Letters are case-insensitive. For example, "scanner" and "Scanner" are considered the same module name and cannot be used repeatedly
parameters.help_zh:
OTA模块名称，产品下唯一且不可修改。仅支持英文字母、数字、英文句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。长度限制为1~64个字符。
英文字母不区分大小写，例如“scanner”和“Scanner”被认为是相同的模块名称，不可重复使用
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.example: 条码扫描仪的固件模块
parameters.help_en: The description of the OTA module. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: OTA模块的描述信息，支持最多100个字符
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the OTA module belongs
parameters.name: product_key
